# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest JellyChat release gets security fixes. JellyChat 2.0 and later need Jellyfin 12.

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you find a security problem, please do not open a public issue for it.

[Report it privately](https://github.com/itsmeares/jellychat/security/advisories/new) through GitHub Security Advisories and include:

- the affected route, setting, or part of the chat
- reproduction steps
- what an attacker could do, for example read another room's messages or act as another user
- any suggested mitigation

## Response goals

- acknowledge receipt promptly
- validate the report
- prepare a fix and release plan
- disclose publicly after a fix is available when appropriate

I would rather get a quiet report early than have someone try to be polite and wait.
